doc.tweak: 26 B big-endian: ctx(8)='EMBERv1\0' | kid u32 | epoch u32 | type u8 (0 leaf,1 node,2 root,3 period) | level u8 | index u32 | tenant u32 (leaf only; 0 otherwise)
doc.node: level l+1 node j = Th(tweak(kid,e,NODE,l+1,j,0), left||right); unpaired last node promoted unchanged; root = top node
doc.token: claims ':E=' b64url_nopad( ver u8=1 | alg u8 (signer_id<<4 | n==32) | kid u32 | epoch u32 | idx u32 | r[16] | path n*d )
doc.signed_root_msg: 'EMBER-root' | kid u32 | epoch u32 | t_start_ms u64 | delta_ms u32 | N u32 | root ; ML-DSA context 'EMBER-root'
doc.signed_root_wire: kid u32|epoch u32|t_start_ms u64|delta_ms u32|N u32|n u8|root|sig
doc.pertoken: claims ':Sig=' b64url_nopad(sig) ; signed message = claims ASCII; ML-DSA context 'CDN-token'; Ed25519/ECDSA sign 'CDN-token'||claims (prefix); HMAC over claims (no prefix)
doc.B11: sig = deleg_id u32 | Ed25519(prefix 'CDN-token'||claims); cert = deleg_id u32|kid u32|ed_pk[32]|not_after u64 || ML-DSA-44 sig (context 'EMBER-deleg') over the 48-B body
doc.validity: accept iff now <= Expires+tau and Expires <= t_start+delta+V_max+tau (seconds; tau=5, V_max=3600) and idx < N and URL has prefix
